title: Palindrome Linked List
description: Check whether a singly linked list reads the same forwards and backwards.

data.text: Given `head`, return true if the linked list is a palindrome.

data.title: Array Copy O(n) O(n)
Two-Pointer + Reverse O(n) O(1)
What improved
data.text: The array approach is simple but needs extra memory proportional to the list size. The in-place method finds the middle node, reverses only the back half, then compares the two halves node by node. No extra list is needed, so memory stays constant.
